label: F38 Meadows village_road High|Medium
brief: Fixed production-camera views of one Meadows location (village road) across times of day and weather, with the 1.80 m trainer as a ruler. Judge whether it reads as the key art's Meadows: a coherent, lived-in place with readable landmarks and light that belongs to the world.
defects: Flat magenta slabs or rings on the ground
Placeholder or untextured materials (flat grey, checker or faceted blocks)
Floating bodies or props (a gap between an object and the ground under it)
Clipping (geometry passing through geometry, or the camera inside geometry)
P2-014: the mountain backdrop has hard isolated facets and dark slash shapes instead of continuous ranges
P2-005: thin grass and the same tall white flowers repeat over broad slopes with few clustered colour or texture changes
P2-006: nearby settlements have little lit life or detail

label: F38 Meadows fight High|Medium
brief: A real Meadows trainer fight (the bridge grunt, then the Warden) through the production camera with ordinary attack and dodge inputs, with telegraphed attacks. Does the fight read on screen - both fighters, telegraphs and impacts clearly visible - and does it look like an event that belongs to the world?
defects: Flat magenta slabs or rings on the ground
P2-062: the oversized ally fills half the combat view and hides the opponent or player
P2-063: tells rely on text while flat magenta floor marks and bright impact flashes carry the hits
P2-064: thick straight turquoise rails outline the Warden floor and cross creature silhouettes
P2-016: hurt and moving frames keep the idle silhouette
